synthesis: No eligible studies were identified for inclusion in this systematic review. The evidence extraction process found 0 randomised or quasi-randomised trials comparing routinely administered cotrimoxazole versus placebo or no treatment in children (age less than 15 years) with HIV infection, or children less than 18 months with HIV infected mothers. Without any included studies, it is not possible to draw conclusions about the effects of cotrimoxazole prophylaxis on death and illness episodes in the target population based on this systematic review process.
limitations: No studies met the inclusion criteria or were available in the search results
Unable to assess effectiveness of cotrimoxazole prophylaxis without any eligible trials
Unable to evaluate risk of bias, methodological quality, or study limitations with zero included studies
Cannot determine publication bias heterogeneity, or generalizability with no data
